text:
Emma: Quick kitchen PSA + poll: decaf is gone and there's a pile of unlabelled mugs on the drying rack. Do we want a granola + decaf run in 20? Also, Mug Amnesty: we'll put all unlabeled mugs in the box by the window on Monday. Claim or it's donation.
Ben: I will 100% join for granola. which brand? crunchy or nut-free?
Carlos: nut-free pls (allergy). also yes to mug amnesty, label your mugs, people.
Zoe: Omg the mug box is overflowing. someone put a tiny cactus in my travel mug last week.
Leo: I can run. preferences: crunchy granola, plain decaf sachets, oatmilk 2L.
KitchenBot: Inventory check: decaf 0 sachets, oatmilk 0.5L, crunchy granola 1 pack, nut-free granola 0 packs. Suggested restock: decaf 20, oatmilk 2L, nut-free granola 3.
Emma: @Leo amazing. Can you also grab a small sign for the mug box? "Mug Amnesty: claim by Mon"?
Leo: Yep. Also checking prices: decaf box $6, granola $5.50, oatmilk $3.80 for 1L.
Ben: I'll chip in $4 for my granola.
Carlos: Sending $6 for nut-free and my oatmilk share.
Zoe: Can we get one of those reusable bamboo spoons too? the plastic ones are gone.
Leo: Added bamboo spoons to the list. Final shopping list: 3 nut-free granola, 2 crunchy granola, decaf box, oatmilk 2L, bamboo spoons, sign. ETA 18 minutes.
Emma: bless. also moved the mystery caramel mug to the top of the box 60a
--- 20 minutes later ---
Leo: Back. Everything got purchased. Leftover: one extra granola (free sample), tiny succulent is alive.
Ben: Pics? :camera_with_flash: 
Leo: Uploaded to #random. Also left receipts on the fridge. Total $34.10.
Emma: Venmo me $4 @Emma. I'll pay Leo back.
Ben: Sent.
Carlos: Sent $6.40. (oops overpaid).
Zoe: Sent $5.70.
KitchenBot: Expense recorded: Leo reimbursed $34.10. Entry saved to team-expenses/2026-04. Reminder: Mug Amnesty claim deadline Monday 09:00.
Emma: Thanks all. Whoever's mug was the tiny cactus, please claim it before the cactus gets attached to someone's laptop.
Zoe: Not mine, I checked.
Carlos: If any unclaimed mugs remain Monday, I'll donate them to the building cafe.
Emma: Agreed. Small ask: can we start putting names on lids? It saves the ecosystem.
Ben: Will label mine now.
Leo: Mug sign taped to the box. Mission accomplished. :white_check_mark:
